description: VAT on an amount: add it to a net amount or take it out of a gross one. UK by default; EU countries and the UAE by country (standard rate if no rate is given). Read-only arithmetic.

amount.description: Amount in the country's currency, e.g. 1000.

country.description: GB (default), DE, FR, NL, IE, ES, IT, BE, AT, PT, FI or AE.

mode.description: add: the amount is net (default). remove: the amount includes VAT.

rate.description: VAT rate in percent; default the country's standard rate.

name: calculate_vat

formatted.description: The amounts formatted for the currency's country.

title: Calculate VAT
